bestFit.how: an e-signature or ATS trigger that fires the moment the offer is countersigned
a Watch module on the ATS, so onboarding starts without anyone remembering to start it
the graph entry, with the offer parsed into typed state before any provisioning runs
a Dataverse entitlements table with an owner in People Ops, edited through a form
a database read keyed on role, returning the entitlement list the plan expands
a Set Variable module minting the hire record once, so every branch reads the same start date
build the record with the start date as a real date object, not a string to re-parse later
a config list of task SLAs, with due dates computed by addDays from the start date
an SLA table with a version; due dates derive from the start date so a moved date recomputes
a data store of SLA offsets read once and applied to every task in the plan
expand the role profile into dated tasks; the plan is data, so a changed role re-expands cleanly
an Item Lists node fanning the entitlements into one task item per branch
Get user, then a Condition, then Create user ONLY if none was returned
check-then-create keyed on the hire id, so a retry converges instead of duplicating
create the procurement ticket and post the tracking number back to the tracker
a ticket-creation module, then a Wait for the shipping confirmation the vendor sends
Apply to each group in the profile, then Add member - only the groups the profile lists
loop the entitlement list adding memberships, and log any grant that was not on the profile
an enrollment card to Payroll; the confirmation writes back to the task tracker
a delayed step that resumes when Payroll submits the confirmation form
one status row per task, updated by task id, so parallel branches cannot overwrite each other
a data store updated per branch outcome, keyed on task id rather than on position
a database upsert per branch, so re-running one branch does not disturb the others
a Condition that ALL task statuses equal done before the assemble branch runs
all() over the tracker rows; one blocked task blocks the gate, by design
create the escalation task with an assignee and a deadline, then notify the owner's manager
a Wait node on the SLA, then a Send node up the ladder when no response arrived
compose the document from the record, tracker, and gate fields, not from retyped values
render the package from the three artifacts, so every line traces to the task that produced it
a synthesis node assembling the package from state, with the artifacts as grounding
'Start and wait for an approval' on the package, addressed to the hiring manager
an approval card carrying the package summary; the reply is captured on the run
write the run to a retained store with a retention label matching the HR policy
a storage module writing the retained run that the catalog feedback later reads
create a catalog change-request record assigned to People Ops when a run needed something off-profile
diff what was actually granted against the profile and file the delta as a change request
